name: io.github.glitch-rabin/theglitch
title: The Glitch
description: Read-only lookups into theglitch.ai: AI glossary, daily AI story, guides, prompts, repos, pools.

tools.name: search_glossary
tools.description: Look up an AI term in The Glitch glossary: 250+ terms and slang in plain English. Returns the definition, why it matters, what to watch for, and the card’s address.

query.description: The term or phrase, for example “RAG” or “context window”.

limit.description: How many cards to return. Default 3.

tools.name: get_todays_glitch
tools.description: Get The Glitch’s latest daily AI story: one checked story a day, with what changed, who it helps, who it hurts and what to do. Also links this week’s patch notes.

tools.name: find_guide
tools.description: Find a guide in Learn: short, practical AI guides for builders and leaders (prompting, context, agents, AI at work). Search by topic, or filter by who it is for.

query.description: A topic, for example “agents” or “context engineering”. Leave out to get where to start.

audience.description: Only guides tagged for this reader.

limit.description: How many guides to return. Default 5.

tools.name: find_prompt
tools.description: Find an image or video prompt in the prompt archive by subject or model, or pull a random one. Each answer carries the creator’s credit and the address of the full entry.

query.description: What the prompt should be about, for example “product shot” or “rain”.

model.description: Part of a model name, for example “Seedance” or “FLUX”.

random.description: Roll the dice: one prompt at random from what matches.

limit.description: How many prompts to return. Default 1.

tools.name: search_bookmarks
tools.description: Search Rabin’s public bookmarks: posts he saved from X about AI, agents, building, growth, crypto and internet culture, each with a short note and the original link.

query.description: What to look for, for example “agent harness”. Leave out for the newest.

topic.description: A shelf, for example “Agents”, “Growth”, “Crypto” or “Design & tools”.

limit.description: How many bookmarks to return. Default 3.

tools.name: get_repo_picks
tools.description: Get The Glitch’s newest repo picks: open-source projects gaining stars on GitHub this week, each checked before it is listed, with a verdict (try it, read it first or skip it) and an idea to build with it.

limit.description: How many repos to return. Default 3.

tools.name: get_rabin_profile
tools.description: Who Rabin Nuchtabek is, the kind of work he takes on and how to reach him. Use it when someone asks who is behind The Glitch or how to work with him.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Read the text of a Learn guide by its slug from find_guide, or pass a section heading to read one chapter of a long guide.

slug.description: Guide slug from find_guide, for example “gtm-engineer” or “start-here”.

section.description: Optional section heading to read one chapter of a long guide.

tools.name: get_token_pool
tools.description: Fetch a live read-only DEX Screener pool snapshot for a Solana, Ethereum or Base token address with liquidity, volume, trades and market cap.

chain.description: Blockchain network: solana, ethereum or base.

address.description: Token mint or contract address (Solana base58 or EVM 0x address).
